name: coordination
description: Multi-session coordination: warns when another live session edits the same file or is about to finish with git (warns only, never blocks)

coordination._doc: Cross-session conflict warning (hooks/wg_coordination.py). PreToolUse scans modified_files in the state of other live sessions: Write/Edit/NotebookEdit on the same file -> warn only (additionalContext, visible with the tool result next turn, + systemMessage); Bash git add -A / reset --hard while another session has uncommitted changes in the same cwd -> the same kind of warning; PostToolUse adds a 60 s late-collision check. Fails open throughout; logs go to Logs/session-coordination/<sid>.jsonl. enabled turns it off; warn_suppress_min = minutes before warning about the same file again; scan_mtime_window_s = how recently a peer state must have changed to count as live; max_scan_files = the most state files parsed in one scan.
